paite: Huai laitak in kumpipa Herod in Jesu tanchin ana za hi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Sihna / (Mar 6.14-29; Luk 9.7-9)

paite: Asikhate kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Baptispa Johan ahi; misi lak a kipan thounawn ahi; huaiziak in huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
Herod in a-unau Philip zi, Herodias ziak in Johan aman a, ahen a, suangkul ah ana khum hi.
Johan in akiang ah amah na neih asiang kei, achih ziak in.
Johan hihlup ut mahleh mipi akihta a, zawlnei hi a apom ziak un.
Himahleh Herod pian ni ahong tun in alai ah Herodias tanu alam a, Herod akipaksak hi.
Huai phet in anget peuhmah pe ding in thu akichiam hi.
Ama'n anu' thuhilh bang in, "Hiai kuang ah Baptispa Johan lutang hon pia in," achi hi.
Kumpipa alungkhamta a, himahleh athuchiamte leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in piak ding thu apia hi.
Huchi in mi asawl a, Johan lutang atansak hi.
Huan kuang in alutang ahon la ua, numei naupang kiang ah apia ua, ama'n anu kiang ah apaipihta hi.
Johan nungzuite'n aluang hong la ua, avui ua, huchi in Jesu ava hilh uhi.
Jesu'n huai thu azak in, hiai a kipan long in gamkeu lam ah apaituamta hi. Himahleh mipi'n azaktak un khua a kipan khe a pai in azuita uhi.
heading: Mipi Sangnga Vakna / (Mar 6.30-44; Luk 9.10-17; Joh 6.1-14)

paite: Huchi in amah ahong paikhiakleh mipi tampitak amu a, ahehpih mahmah a, adamloute uh ahihdamsak hi.
Nitaklam ahong hih in, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Hiai mun gamkeu ahi a, ni akaita a, mipite khuate apai a, amau a ding nek ding aleitheihna ding un paisakta in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Apaimang uh akiphamoh kei, noumau nek ding pia un," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hiai ah tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih kia i nei uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Huaite ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi.

Huchi in loupa tung a tu ding in mipite thu apia a, tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nihte ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah tanghoute apia a, mipite kiang ah nungzuite'n apesawn uhi.
Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval uh bawmpi sawm-le-nih dim angah uhi.
Anete numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangnga vel ahi uh.
Huan mipite asawlmang khit in apai ma a gal khat na pai masa ding in nungzuite long ah atuangsak teitei hi.
heading: Tui Tung Ah Khe In Jesu Apai / (Mar 6.45-52; Joh 6.15-21)

paite: Mipite apaimang nung un thum ding in tang ah atuam in apaitou a, nitaklam ahong hih in huai ah amah kia in a-omta hi.
Tuipi laitak ah long a-omta a; huih in ahilou lam a asawn ziak in tuikihot in asepta hi.
Zanven lina ah tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, akiang lam uh hon zuan in amu uhi.
Nungzuite'n amah tuipi tung a khe apai amuh un, "Sikha ahi," chi in abuai ua, lau in akikouta uhi.
Himahleh Jesu'n amaute ahoupih pah a, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
Peter in adawng a, "Toupa, nang na hihleh tui tung ah nang kiang a hong pai thu hon pia in," achi hi.
Huan ama'n, "Hong pai ve,” achi a, long a kipan Peter akum a, Jesu kiang zuan in tui tung ah khe in apaita hi.
Himahleh huih nung amuh in alau a, tum ding in akisa a, "Toupa, hon hondam in," chi in akikou hi.
Jesu'n asawk pah a, amah alen a, akiang ah, "Nang gintawm, bangziak a ginglah na hia?" achi hi.
Huan long a atuan uleh huih adaita hi.
Long a omte'n, "Pathian Tapa na hi taktak hi," chi in amah abia uhi.
Huan gal khat lam akai uleh, Gennesaret gam ahong tung uhi.
heading: Gennesaret A Damlou Hihdamna / (Mar 6.53-56)

paite: Huai mun a mite'n amah atheihtak un, huai kim gam tengteng ah mi asawl ua, damlou tengteng akiang ah ahon pi ua;
Apuan mong bek khoih theih angen ngutngut ua; huan akhoih peuhmah adam zel uhi.
